Complete Feature Set

Explore every capability NexDine offers to modernize your restaurant operations.

All-in-One Platform

Everything Your Restaurant Needs

Replace your stack of disconnected tools with a single, unified platform that talks to itself.

POS & Billing

Quick 3-click billing with customizable menus, split bills, merge tables, and multi-payment support.

Inventory Management

Item-wise auto deduction, low-stock alerts, purchase orders, recipe costing, and day-end reports.

Menu Management

Create and customize menus per service type. Toggle items ON/OFF based on stock availability.

Kitchen Display System

Real-time order routing to kitchen stations with timers, alerts, and course management.

QR Ordering

Customers scan, browse, and order directly from their phones — no app download needed.

Table & Area Management

Configure dine-in areas with menus, tax rates, custom seating, merge/split, and live occupancy.

Multi-Terminal Billing

Multiple billing counters synced with one master station. Captains generate KOTs from any terminal.

Station-wise KOT Printing

Assign printers to cooking stations. KOTs route automatically to the right counter.

80+ Reports & Analytics

Day-end sales, online orders, staff actions, inventory consumption, and real-time dashboards.

Online Order Management

Unified inbox for Swiggy, Zomato, and other platforms. Auto-accept, menu sync, and reconciliation.

CRM & Loyalty

Customer profiles, reward points, automated promotions, birthday campaigns, and feedback loops.

WhatsApp & SMS Marketing

Order confirmations, campaigns, reservation reminders, and win-back messages via WhatsApp and SMS.

Captain / Waiter App

Full-featured handheld ordering with offline support, tableside payment, and instant kitchen fire.

Self-Ordering Kiosk

Touch-screen kiosks for customers to browse, customize, and place orders without staff.

Scan & Pay

Customers scan a QR code to view their bill and pay instantly via UPI, cards, or wallets.

Waiter Calling System

Digital call buttons on tables so customers can request service without raising a hand.

Reservation Manager

Online booking widget, waitlist management, table-specific holds, and reminder notifications.

Token Management

Display token numbers on screens for takeaway and delivery orders. Real-time status updates.

Tax & Discount Engine

Configure GST, VAT, service charges, coupons, and discounts by service type or region.

Role & Permissions

Granular access control for waiters, managers, kitchen staff, and accountants to prevent fraud.

Works Offline

Cloud-based with offline mode. Continue billing without internet — syncs automatically when back online.

150+ Integrations

Payment gateways, delivery platforms, accounting tools, loyalty apps — all from a single dashboard.

Customer Feedback

Collect ratings, comments, and tags for every order. Track sentiment trends by dish and branch.

Print Job Monitoring

Real-time print queue with diagnostics, retry failed jobs, and printer health dashboards.

Built for All Formats

Fine dine, QSR, cloud kitchen, café, bar, bakery, food court, large chains — one platform fits all.
